about: Final guarded exploratory H3 v3 continuation. V1 stopped at the 192-request per-episode ceiling; v2 crossed it but stopped at the 300000-token per-episode ceiling after 218 Warrant requests. V2's 195 spans were labeled; the later ARGUS grounding search raised input tokens. Cases, prompts, methods, model, scorer and analysis stay fixed. V1 and v2 invalid rows are retained separately and never pooled. Use --set h3_cases=<path> --set h3_plan=<path> --set results_root=<confirmed checkout> and --artifact-root <pinned ARGUS checkout>.
authorization_basis: User directed execution after a concrete plan without another confirmation. V1 actual $0.04668510 plus v2 actual $0.10174770 plus v3 S1 maximum $0.60 and conditional v3 S2 maximum $2.50 equals $3.24843280, below the previously presented $3.25 total. This is the final guarded rerun; if v3 S1 is incomplete, stop this ARGUS H3 route rather than raising caps again.

case_plan.cases: 2 GT-validated dev pairs (workspace user_task_35 and slack user_task_2); banking user_task_2 is eval held out
case_plan.full_plan: 2 pairs x 2 arms x 5 repeats = 20 episodes per row

pricing_reverification.basis: Conservative peak, input cache hits charged as misses. The shared guard's historical 2026-09-30 snapshot has the same numeric rates; its receipt retains that historical id. Recheck alias and rates before any paid launch.

cost_anchor.source: V1 and v2 H3-S1 results experiments 20261010-deepseek-h3-exploratory-v1 and -v2; after-data operational-bound correction
cost_anchor.observed: V1: 195 requests, 149206 tokens, $0.04668510. V2: 221 requests, 332118 tokens, $0.10174770. Both had one valid none row and one invalid workspace Warrant row; no H3 effect.
cost_anchor.maximum_episode: V2 workspace Warrant reached 218 requests and 304102 tokens before local refusal. All 195 context spans had been labeled. Remaining grounding and audit work was extrapolated at roughly 120000-140000 tokens for the first audit, plus possible agent retry.
cost_anchor.caps_rule: V3 S1 $0.60 and conditional S2 $2.50 keep all three experiments' actual-plus-maximum below $3.25. Episode limits are 640 requests and 1M tokens; stage guards are stricter in aggregate. S2 also requires 1.2 times 5 times S1 actual USD/tokens/requests to fit its caps. If v3 S1 fails, stop; no fourth cap increase.

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for AgentDojo agent and ARGUS Warrant judges

H3-S1-V3.description: Final fresh H3 v3 smoke: both GT-validated dev pairs, TOOL_L and PROMPT_L, one repeat, none and Warrant rows. Four episodes per row; check prompt override, L proposal/audit, native utility parity, judge failures and cost before H3-S2-V3. V1/v2 rows are not reused.

estimate.anchor: V2 first Warrant row 218 requests / 304102 episode tokens before local refusal; extrapolated first audit 420k-440k, possible agent retry; H3 task transfer unverified

H3-S1-V3.compares_to: Same task and native utility across prompt arms; no attacker or H2 attack outcome.

H3-S2-V3.description: Exploratory H3 v3 full dev pair panel: both cases x TOOL_L/PROMPT_L x five repeats x none/Warrant (40 fresh sample-rows). Prior S1 rows are diagnostic and are not pooled into this stage. Run only if all V3 S1 prerequisites and the 1.2x cost/workload projection pass.

estimate.anchor: Use completed V3 S1 totals to test the pre-stated 1.2 x 5 workload/cost projection before launch; do not extrapolate from invalid V1/V2 rows

H3-S2-V3.compares_to: Warrant false block on L from tool data versus L also stated in user prompt, conditional on complete planned rows and per-case undefended utility parity.
